scope: Earlier file-lease preparation parent hard-exit. Existing helper/worker Job results do not cover the transient OS PowerShell before product helper ownership.
currentTopology: Node parent starts canonical Windows PowerShell with fixed script and private stdin
PowerShell waits for EOF and deserializes JSON; only then loads the pinned lease DLL from request bytes
DLL Run authenticates actual OS parent and checks the held parent handle before each operation
DLL locks/hashes local files, duplicates leases into parent; returns; PowerShell serializes response and exits
Only after acquisition does Node start the product double-Job helper

actualGaps.interval: CreateProcess(PowerShell) through first executable script instruction
actualGaps.protection: Only OS scheduling/startup and the external research containment Job in prior probes. No current product Job or watcher.

actualGaps.interval: Console.ReadToEnd, JSON/GAC assembly load and lease-DLL load before Run
actualGaps.protection: No independent parent watcher. EOF or eventual Run Alive is not independent termination.

actualGaps.interval: Run while file open, hashing, duplication or response serialization is blocked
actualGaps.protection: Only stepwise Alive(parent), cannot interrupt an in-progress blocking operation.

candidateArmOnly.implementation: New separately pinned DLL and fixed PS script may load bounded verified DLL bytes first, then Arm against actual OS parent PID+creation while holding one process HANDLE, then read stdin and perform Run. Independent background native wait kills only its current PowerShell process for parent signaled or any unexpected wait result; retain guard until actual PowerShell exit, not just Run return.
benefit: Closes P2 after Arm and can move ReadToEnd behind Arm
Does not use PID-only kill or depend on stdin/stdout/hash progress
candidateArmOnly.residual: P0 and DLL read/hash/Assembly.Load before Arm remain unprotected. Must never qualify whole bootstrap hard-exit from an Arm-after-load test.
candidateArmOnly.noCircularProof: Cannot use this same unguarded PowerShell to acquire the initial lease required to launch its own guardian.

recommendedWholeTopology.name: Native application-entry Job owner, before Node is created
flow: A small fixed native launcher is the installed/user-invoked Ruyi entrypoint, rather than a child binary authenticated later by Node through the unguarded PowerShell
Launcher creates a non-inheritable unnamed KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE Job; sole Job handle stays in launcher

Create the application Node process suspended with explicit stdio handle whitelist and no BREAKAWAY; assign it to the Job; only then resume. Assign failure terminates and waits the suspended child, fail closed
Every future lease PowerShell/helper/worker spawned by Node automatically inherits this Job before it can execute, including the current pre-DLL and pre-Arm windows
Launcher independently waits a held Node process handle; Node exit closes/terminates the Job and observes active0. Launcher hard-death closes the sole handle and kernel reaps descendants
Normal shutdown evidence still uses product proxy private ACK, observed worker/helper and lease cleanup. The new outer application Job cannot upgrade an inner unknown to observed

authority.root: The launch entrypoint belongs to the same external installation/package trust root as the current user-invoked Ruyi executable. It is not a JS runtime factory authorized from caller-supplied hashes or env.
required: Reviewed reproducible build/source/binary pins in package manifest and signed/reviewed delivery
Explicit support policy for protected install versus portable launch paths; package/update transaction must preserve initial executable authority
Canonical relative bundled Node/application path and fixed approved bytes; no caller-supplied executable or script
Windows nested-Job compatibility must be tested under actual desktop outer Jobs and restrictions
authority.unresolved: A new helper dynamically cp.spawned from arbitrary user-writable paths after a JS hash check recreates the image TOCTOU and is not the proposed trust root. Existing file-lease PS cannot be its circular authority. Initial entrypoint delivery/portable authority must be accepted explicitly; fixed local PowerShell SHA is not a cross-Windows answer.

scopeCosts: Moves or adds the initial application executable role and packaging/startup integration; not a tiny 06hb-only patch
All Node descendants inherit the application Job; effects on user tool/terminal processes that may intentionally survive application closure require product review
No ActiveProcessLimit=2 at application root: ordinary app children and nested product Jobs must remain functional
Must not retain product Job handle in independent observers or child processes
Normal UI/HTTP readiness remains nonblocking and real resident warm semantics unchanged
recommendedWholeTopology.notYetEvidence: No new source, binary, native compilation or experiment in this design; existing approved flush helper/DLL remain immutable.

alternativeEarlyClrWatcher.idea: An inbox .NET compiled expression EventHandler could monitor a held claimed-parent Process handle before reading the DLL, without a new executable. It removes DLL I/O from the unchecked region but still has PowerShell startup/guard registration window, needs actual OS parent authentication and runtime-thread tests; not equivalent to inheriting a Job at CreateProcess.
alternativeEarlyClrWatcher.reasonNotClaimed: Does not close P0 and adds another asynchronous guard implementation. Do not silently treat it as whole-topology proof.

proposedNativeBatches.claim: Only post-Arm interval, not whole bootstrap
proposedNativeBatches.trigger: Actual fixed new broker emits a bounded typed watcher-ready witness then its stdin is withheld by transparent test transport. External coordinator validates held parent PID/creation/image and kills through the same native HANDLE.
mustObserve: Broker exact identity absent before a deadline excluding its own watchdog
Independent coordinator remains alive; no outer containment kill
Local file leases are not retained after both owning processes exit
proposedNativeBatches.pending: Separate DLL compile/source authority and root decision first

proposedNativeBatches.claim: Whole topology before DLL/input if entry Job approved
proposedNativeBatches.trigger: Actual application-entry launcher starts actual Node inside Job. Node starts broker with first stdin bytes withheld. Same-HANDLE kill Node after independent broker identity evidence.
mustObserve: Broker/helper/worker exact identities absent while coordinator is alive
Launcher held Node exit observed and actual app Job active0 before research fallback
Record timings from broker CreateProcess to parent kill and broker OS absence; do not accept natural JS/PS watchdog exit
No replacement; no fallback cleanup contributes to PASS

proposedNativeBatches.trigger: Same-HANDLE kill the actual sole-Job-handle launcher while Node and broker live.
mustObserve: Node and broker disappear by product kernel close-on-job mechanism before external fallback
No independent observer holds or duplicates product Job handle
Normal inner ACK absence stays unknown even when all OS processes are absent

proposedNativeBatches.trigger: Blocked stdin/stdout and restrictive enclosing Job tests, separately frozen.
mustObserve: Parent monitoring independent of every I/O pump
Nested assign incompatibility fails closed before child resume
Two instances cannot terminate or clear each other; do not use global process-name kills
